name: FNAL-E-0021
summary: The Caltech-Fermilab E21 programme was an early electronic high-energy neutrino experiment at the new National Accelerator Laboratory, demonstrating neutrino detection and developing calorimetric measurements.
physics_targets: Weak interactions and calorimetric detector development
detection_principle: A massive instrumented target recorded hadronic energy while spark chambers and downstream magnetic analysis characterized muons. This electronic arrangement allowed high-energy neutrino interactions to be reconstructed beyond the rate available in photographic chambers.
